subject: Accessibility
label: WEBSITE ACCESS
caption:
Making your website easier to use isn't about aesthetics—it's about removing the friction that stops people from buying. When your site is easy to read and navigate, search engines also rank it higher.

If you want to know if your site has these hidden barriers, DM me the word AUDIT. I’ll send you a quick, manual video review of your homepage with three practical fixes.

#webdesign #usability #conversionrate #smallbusiness #webdesigner

slides.title: Your website is quietly blocking paying customers.
slides.body: If your text is hard to read or buttons are tough to tap, you are turning away buyers. People don't struggle through bad design; they just buy from a competitor with an easier site.

slides.title: Light gray text kills mobile sales.
slides.body: Low-contrast gray text is nearly invisible on mobile screens in daylight. If customers have to squint to read your pricing or offer, they will close the tab and find an easier option.

slides.title: Small, crowded buttons cause abandoned carts.
slides.body: If your links and buttons are too close together, one-handed phone users will misclick. When tapping 'Checkout' accidentally opens a different page, frustrated users simply give up.

slides.title: Get a free, manual homepage check.
slides.body: I will personally test your homepage for these contrast and mobile issues. No automated templates, just three practical fixes to stop losing sales. DM me 'AUDIT' to get started.
